channel.title: summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: A hidden 'on switch' in human DNA has finally been decoded
item.description: Using AI, researchers identified the DNA signature of a genetic switch that activates genes, based on about 500,000 sequences.

item.title: Experimental compound helps burn fat without muscle loss
item.description: A decades-old compound may offer a new obesity treatment by increasing energy expenditure. In mice, it showed promise.

item.title: Physicists create a tiny 'Big Bang' with unexpectedly small atomic nuclei
item.description: CERN researchers produced miniature versions of the early Universe by colliding very small atomic nuclei at near-light speed.

item.title: Common vitamin linked to 13% better cognitive scores
item.description: Older adults with mild cognitive impairment and sleep issues who took at least 5,000 IU of vitamin D daily scored over 13% higher on a cognitive test.
